limits: Selected-source synthesis, not a systematic review or exhaustive state-law census.
Historical repository DOCX/PDF payloads were not read; the new synthesis does not claim their complete incorporation.
No fixed ATS rejection-rate estimate is accepted.
verification_note: Source inspected through web retrieval at the stated access level. Full text was not reviewed where an abstract or excerpt is specified. No copyrighted source payload is redistributed.
